decision_rule: Prospective synthetic multi-file diagnostic, not the canonical BEP suite or route authority. Five distinct tasks, three interleaved arms, fresh server per request, temperature zero. Require every full edit verifier and in-request GPU residency PASS, exact same-slot counts, and five complete matched blocks. In the pinned v10 binary, a complete, untruncated sole-request response with both draft fields absent and no same-slot acceptance log is zero proposed tokens and has undefined proposing-round mean; partial or contradictory cases are UNKNOWN. For positive proposals use exact response counts and a uniquely reconstructible proposing-round count from the inclusive rounded-log interval; ambiguity, invalid edits or any incomplete cell is UNKNOWN and stop on futility, with no adaptive extension. Report paired geometric mean lookup/DFlash2 decode speed and weighted accepted length; ratio >=1.5 is a candidate signal only, never a routing decision.
